analyst_view.overall: Lille are 35th with 1 point from 4 games and lost 1-0 at home to Lyon on Saturday, so this is close to their last chance to reach the play-offs; Tiago Santos, Nianzou and Igamane are out (counted). Bayern (13th, 8 points) drew 1-1 with Köln on Friday and are badly hit: Harry Kane tore ankle ligaments, had surgery and is out for about three months, and Gnabry, Saibari, Davies and Neuer are also out; the numbers now count all of these, Kane alone taking 15% off Bayern's goals. What the numbers do not list is Michael Olise, who left the Köln game on crutches with a bruised foot; Bild and club president Hainer both suggest he will miss Lille, with Hamburg on 28 November a possible return. Goal expects an unusual Bayern front line with Lennart Karl through the middle, while Musiala is back but not fully fit and Luis Díaz may return. No referee is named yet.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.6 goals, 1.5 of them Bayern's, and already take Kane, Gnabry, Saibari and Davies off (about -25% on Bayern). Olise, Bayern's other main creator and scorer, is likely out too and the numbers don't know it, so I take a further 6% off, to about 2.4. I keep it moderate because it is not confirmed and Díaz and Musiala may add something.

corners.text: The numbers expect 9.7 corners, split almost evenly. Bayern without Kane and Olise may be less direct but should still have the ball, while Lille must push for a win at home; these pull in opposite directions, so I stay at 9.7.

cards.text: The numbers expect 3.3 cards and already take about 12% off Bayern for their low recent card count. The referee is not named yet. Lille's must-win mood could add a booking late on, but that is a hunch, so I stay at 3.3.

shots.text: The numbers say 25 shots, nearly 15 from Bayern. The missing-player adjustment only moves goals, and losing Olise, one of their most frequent shooters, on top of Kane should cut Bayern's volume somewhat with a makeshift front line; Lille needing a win stops me going further. About 24.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.1 shots on target. Olise is likely out, which the numbers don't see, and a young front line led by Lennart Karl should be less accurate than Bayern's usual one. I go down to about 8.6.
